scientific.integrity: The previous all-dimensional centered-plank optimization is already established by Bakaev and Polyanskii (arXiv:2607.27483v1). The remaining asserted contribution is the precise sharp symmetric-difference displacement deficit for aligned full-utilization planks. Its proof uses exact slicing and two monotone-density mass exchanges; no finite computation establishes the all-dimensional quantifiers.
limitations: The basic centered plank optimum and formula are prior-covered and are background only, not original findings.
The exact deficit profile assumes common plank normal and full one-dimensional utilized width |E|=W.
No claim is made for nonparallel planks, overlap, or wasted out-of-ball normal-coordinate width.
The deficit formula follows from a classical rearrangement technique; unindexed quantitative variants are residual originality risks.

title: Sharp positional stability for aligned plank coverage of a Euclidean ball
